coverageHint: Each requirement completeness score adds 30 points for any test design, 40 for any linked test case, and 30 when any linked case has automation_status = AUTOMATED. A requirement counts as covered at 70 points or more; aggregate Requirement Coverage is the share meeting that threshold. This score is not automation coverage.
coverageScrollHint: Swipe horizontally, or focus this table and use the left and right arrow keys to view all columns.
coverageSearchPlaceholder: Find by requirement title or ID
coverageNoCases: No test cases are linked to this requirement.

risksHint: Lists P0 automation gaps, flaky tests, persistent failures, and recent defects. Use the metrics above for requirement and execution coverage. Item scores are source-specific signal strengths, not probabilities.
risksEmpty: No risk signals are currently recorded. This does not confirm overall quality or release readiness; assess the available requirements and execution evidence.
